pi-default.description: Compatibility profile for standard OpenAI work through Pi; subscription access is user-confirmed, runtime capability verification is still required.

codex.description: Compatibility profile for explicitly selected Codex CLI work through ChatGPT subscription login; never an automatic fallback.

claude-code.description: Compatibility profile for standard Claude work through Claude Code's subscription path; never route Anthropic models through Pi or Codex.

scout-fast.description: Bounded file discovery, interface summaries, and evidence gathering through Claude Code; not substantive safety analysis.

tester-fast.description: Execute prescribed checks and report evidence through Claude Code; test design and nontrivial diagnosis use tester-analysis instead.

tester-analysis.description: Regression design and substantive failure diagnosis through Claude Code; select before launch, not as automatic escalation.

tester-analysis-pi.description: Explicit OpenAI-through-Pi counterpart to tester-analysis; never an automatic fallback.

tester-analysis-codex.description: Explicit Codex counterpart to tester-analysis; not a fallback when Pi is unavailable.

developer-standard.description: Routine implementation and bounded fixes through Claude Code (the default worker profile). High-risk work requires explicit plan/profile approval.

developer-pi.description: Explicit OpenAI-through-Pi counterpart to developer-standard; never an automatic fallback.

developer-codex.description: Explicit Codex counterpart to developer-standard; not an automatic runtime fallback.

reviewer-standard.description: Independent ordinary correctness and maintainability review through Claude Code only.

safety-review.description: Explicitly assigned review of containment, authentication, approval validity, lifecycle, or integration safety; never automatic effort escalation.

rules.when: Bounded file discovery, interface summaries, or evidence gathering without substantive safety analysis.
rules.why: Use the lighter model for narrowly scoped discovery.

rules.when: Run already prescribed checks and report their results; no regression design or nontrivial failure diagnosis.
rules.why: Mechanical test execution does not require the strongest model.

rules.when: Design regression tests or investigate failures. Prefer Claude Code; choose Pi or Codex only explicitly in the approved assignment.
rules.why: Use a substantive reasoning profile for test design and diagnosis; candidates are choices, not a fallback chain.

rules.when: Routine implementation or bounded fixes. Prefer Claude Code; choose Pi or Codex only explicitly in the approved assignment. High-risk changes require explicit plan/profile approval.
rules.why: Use the standard coding profile without blanket high-effort assignments or automatic runtime substitution.

rules.when: Ordinary correctness and maintainability review, excluding containment, authentication, approval validity, lifecycle, and integration safety.
rules.why: Use Sonnet for ordinary review without assigning Opus to every review.

rules.when: Explicitly assigned safety-critical review of containment, authentication, approval validity, lifecycle, or integration safety.
rules.why: Reserve Opus/high for identified high-risk review, selected before launch rather than automatically escalated.
